meta.title: Streaming Reconnection, Buffering & Integration Tests
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Implement robust reconnection and buffering for the streaming adapter with comprehensive tests to ensure live trading survives network failures.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Reconnection with exponential backoff: delay = min(base * 2^attempts, max_delay)
Messages buffered during brief disconnections (less than 30 seconds), processed on reconnect
Integration tests pass on Lighter.xyz testnet, skip if no credentials

key-tasks.task: Implement reconnect() async method with exponential backoff
Implement message buffering (bounded queue, discard after 30 seconds)
Write unit tests for reconnection logic

architecture-context.pattern: delay = min(base * 2^attempts, max_delay) Reset counter on successful reconnect.

technical-specifications.spec:
self._message_buffer: deque = deque(maxlen=1000) self._buffering = False
async def _on_disconnect(self): self._buffering = True self._disconnect_time = time.monotonic()
async def _on_reconnect(self): if time.monotonic() - self._disconnect_time > 30: self._message_buffer.clear() logger.warning("buffer_discarded_due_to_long_disconnect") else: while self._message_buffer: message = self._message_buffer.popleft() await self._process_message(message) self._buffering = False
